passages.provision_quote: That Section 31 of Article I thereof is repealed.
passages.note: The operative section repeals the Proposition 209 ban, which permits race- and sex-conscious programmes but creates, mandates and enforces nothing.

rows.reasoning: Ramos voted Aye on ACA 5 (2019-2020), whose operative section is "That Section 31 of Article I thereof is repealed." — a repeal that permits race- and sex-conscious programmes rather than requiring any. It therefore does not "strengthen civil rights enforcement", and at most touches "address systemic discrimination"; the compound rung is only half met. It is also not "eliminate affirmative action and all race-based government programs" (the opposite side), and the recital findings about Proposition 209's effects cannot carry a chair the operative section does not.
